verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents personal access tokens that let scripts and tools use the REST API or Git over HTTPS 'with only the permissions you grant'. These tokens always expire. MCP connections can also be limited to 'Only select repositories', so an agent can be given scoped, least-privilege credentials. Missing for 10: a documented list of permission scopes and their granularity, a separate agent or bot identity (tokens act 'as you'), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
